task.title: Atypical nucleus?
task.blurb: Half the nuclei are bland: normal size, pale, smooth outline, fine chromatin. Half are atypical in at least one way: enlarged, hyperchromatic, irregular in outline or coarse in chromatin, alone or in combination. Elongation, rotation and position in the crop are decoys (no nucleoli in this set). Measured the way a morphometry program would, each trait shows up in a different number.
task.signal: size, darkness, contour and chromatin texture, in any combination
